# University of Alberta

> > The University of Alberta is a comprehensive research university in Alberta, Canada, offering undergraduate and graduate programs across the Faculty of Arts, Faculty of Science, Engineering, Education, Nursing, and Augustana Campus.

The University of Alberta provides diverse undergraduate programs including honors degrees, co-operative education options, after-degree teacher certification, and specialized programs across multiple faculties. Programs span liberal arts, sciences, engineering disciplines, health professions, and fine arts, with offerings at both the Edmonton and Augustana campuses.

## Science Programs

- [Biochemistry | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-with-honors-biochemistry.html): BSc Honors Biochemistry with research thesis in Faculty of Science
- [Neuroscience | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-with-major-neuroscience.html): BSc Neuroscience major via Neuroscience and Mental Health Institute
- [Molecular, Cellular and Developmental Biology | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-with-major-molecular-cellular-and-developmental-biology.html): BSc major in Molecular, Cellular & Developmental Biology in Faculty of Sci
- [Environmental Earth Sciences | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-with-honors-environmental-earth-sciences.html): BSc Honors Environmental Earth Sciences with research thesis
- [Mathematics and Finance | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-with-major-mathematics-and-finance.html): BSc Mathematics & Finance major covering actuarial science and risk mgmt
- [Mathematics and Finance (Honors) | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-with-honors-mathematics-and-finance.html): BSc Honors Mathematics & Finance with actuarial science focus
- [Undeclared | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-undeclared.html): BSc Undeclared first-year at Edmonton or Augustana Campus

## Engineering and Co-operative Programs

- [Environmental Engineering | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-in-civil-engineering-environmental-engineering-co-operative-environmental-engineering.html): BSc Civil Engineering with Environmental Engineering co-op program
- [Mining Engineering | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-in-mining-engineering-co-operative-mining-engineering.html): BSc Mining Engineering co-op focusing on clean energy & critical minerals
- [Bioprocessing + Biomanufacturing Co-operative | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-in-chemical-engineering-co-operative-bioprocessing-biomanufacturing.html): BSc Chemical Engineering co-op with Bioprocessing & Biomanufacturing option

## Health and Nursing Programs

- [Nursing | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-science-in-nursing-nursing.html): BScN registered nurse program with Red Deer Polytechnic & Keyano College

## Education and Teacher Certification

- [Art | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-education-in-secondary-education-after-degree-art.html): BEd Secondary Education after-degree for art teacher certification
- [Chemistry | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-education-in-secondary-education-after-degree-chemistry.html): BEd Secondary Education after-degree for chemistry teacher certification
- [Career and Technology Studies: Design | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-education-in-secondary-education-after-degree-career-and-technology-studies-design.html): BEd Secondary after-degree for Career & Technology Studies Design teachers
- [Drama | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-arts-drama-drama.html): BA/BEd combined Drama major with secondary teacher education

## Arts and Fine Arts Programs

- [Art and Design | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-fine-arts-in-art-and-design-art-and-design.html): BFA Art & Design with portfolio requirements and studio art focus
- [Études canadiennes | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/baccalaureat-es-arts-etudes-canadiennes.html): BA Canadian Studies in French at Campus Saint-Jean
- [Undeclared (Augustana) | Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/bachelor-of-arts-undeclared-augustana.html): BA Undeclared first-year program at Augustana Campus in Camrose
